## Requirement Completeness — Communication Patterns

- [ ] CHK006 Are both tell (fire-and-forget) and ask (request-response) communication semantics explicitly defined with delivery guarantees? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003] — *Delivery guarantees (at-most-once, at-least-once) not stated*
- [X] CHK007 Is the ask timeout behavior fully specified — what the caller receives, what happens to the actor's late response? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK008 Are requirements defined for what happens when a tell message is sent to a terminated actor? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the ActorRef cloneability and thread-safety requirement explicitly documented? [Gap] — *Cloneability documented; thread-safety (Send + Sync) not stated*
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements specified for the typed nature of ActorRef — can a ref for ActorA be used to send ActorB's messages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003] — *"Typed" mentioned but not elaborated with compile-time safety semantics*

## Notes

- This checklist tests the *quality of the requirements* in spec.md, not the implementation.
- Items marked [Gap] identify requirements that may be missing from the specification entirely.
- Items marked [Clarity] identify requirements that exist but may be ambiguous.
- Items marked [Consistency] verify alignment with upstream Phase 1/2 artifacts.
- The existing `requirements.md` checklist validates general spec quality; this checklist validates domain-specific actor/supervision requirements depth.
- **18 failing items are planning-phase concerns** — they represent spec gaps that the implementation plan should resolve with concrete design decisions rather than blocking the spec phase.
